comment: Asset keys the shim pre-loads through __crcbl_web_fetch_* before the demo boots. viewer has none: the glTF document it opens is generated by apps/viewer/src/demo_model.rs and compiled into the wasm module, along with the font atlas and the shaders. That is deliberate rather than temporary — this workspace does not vendor a .glb, because a binary fixture is one nobody reviewing a change can read. A document the visitor chooses does not come through here either: it is dropped on the canvas and pushed straight into wasm memory by web/demos/viewer/main.js, so it is never a key and never fetched. The list is the seam, not the content.
